{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify rows with missing age (customer_age == -1)
missing_age_rows = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print("Number of rows with missing age (customer_age == -1):", len(missing_age_rows))

# Identify QA rows (revenue == '999,999.99')
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print("Number of QA rows (revenue == '999,999.99'):", len(qa_rows))

# Check if any QA rows are in the converted group
qa_converted = qa_rows[qa_rows['converted'] == 1]
print("Number of QA rows with converted = 1:", len(qa_converted))

# Now filter the data: only converted customers, excluding missing age and QA rows
df_clean = df[  
    (df['customer_age'] != -1) &  
    (df['revenue'] != '999,999.99') &  
    (df['converted'] == 1)  
]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()
print("Mean age of converted customers (after filtering):", mean_age_converted)

# Final sample size
print("Final number of converted customers with valid age and non-QA revenue:", len(df_clean))"}
